title: The cavalcade
html_source: picture postcards captioned “Viceroy’s entrance into Dublin.”

anchor.prefix: drove out after luncheon from the viceregal lodge. In the following carriage were the honourable Mrs Paget, Miss de Courcy and the honourable Gerald Ward A.D.C. in attendance.
anchor.suffix: passed out by the lower gate of Phoenix park saluted 1932#226by obsequious policemen and proceeded past Kingsbridge along the northern quays. The viceroy was most cordially greete
